text.p: Groupe Jean-Claude Darmon, a football advertising group, said on Wednesday its six-month turnover to December 31, 1996 slipped to 300.18 million francs ($52.8 million) against 337.00 million for the year earlier period.

It said in a statement the fall in 1996/97 first-half turnover was due to a smaller than usual number of sporting events in the period and an early elimination of French football clubs from European cup championships.
Darmon said its first half performance coincided with a slack part of the sporting season.

It said it still expected to be able to achieve its objective of full year turnover of 713 million francs, which the group forecast when it floated 15 percent of its capital on the Paris bourse second market in December. ($ = 5.683 French Francs)
